mapper.insert: insert into learning_study_record (user_id, study_date, seconds, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{studyDate}, #{seconds}, sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update seconds = seconds + #{seconds}, update_time = sysdate()

insert into learning_study_record (user_id, study_date, seconds, article_seconds, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{studyDate}, #{seconds}, #{seconds}, sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update seconds = seconds + #{seconds}, article_seconds = article_seconds + #{seconds}, update_time = sysdate()
mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(seconds), 0) from learning_study_record where user_id = #{userId} and study_date = #{studyDate}
select ifnull(sum(article_seconds), 0) from learning_study_record where user_id = #{userId} and study_date = #{studyDate}
select study_date from learning_study_record where user_id = #{userId} and study_date >= #{fromDate} and seconds > 0 order by study_date desc
mapper.insert: insert into learning_course_progress (user_id, course_id, video_id, finished, watched_seconds, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{courseId}, #{videoId}, #{finished}, #{seconds}, sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update finished = greatest(finished, #{finished}), watched_seconds = watched_seconds + #{seconds}, update_time = sysdate()
mapper.select: select course_id from learning_course_video where video_id = #{videoId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update learning_course_video set duration = #{duration} where video_id = #{videoId} and duration is null and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select count(*) from learning_short_video where video_id = #{videoId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0'

select count(*) from ( select c.course_id from learning_course c join learning_course_video v on v.course_id = c.course_id and v.del_flag = '0' left join learning_course_progress p on p.user_id = #{userId} and p.video_id = v.video_id and p.finished = 1 where c.del_flag = '0' group by c.course_id having count(*) = count(p.video_id) ) t
select count(*) from learning_course_progress where user_id = #{userId} and finished = 0 and watched_seconds > 0
select count(*) from learning_note where user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'
select ifnull(sum(article_seconds), 0) from learning_study_record where user_id = #{userId} and study_date between #{start} and #{end}

select count(*) from ( select c.course_id from learning_course c join learning_course_video v on v.course_id = c.course_id and v.del_flag = '0' left join learning_course_progress p on p.user_id = #{userId} and p.video_id = v.video_id where c.del_flag = '0' group by c.course_id having sum(case when p.watched_seconds > 0 then 1 else 0 end) > 0 and sum(case when p.finished = 1 then 1 else 0 end) < count(*) ) t

select c.course_id as courseId, c.course_name as courseTitle, c.cover_url as coverUrl, count(v.video_id) as totalLessons, count(case when p.finished = 1 then 1 end) as finishedLessons, cast(round(count(case when p.finished = 1 then 1 end) * 100.0 / nullif(count(v.video_id), 0)) as signed) as progressPercent, (select v2.video_title from learning_course_progress p2 join learning_course_video v2 on v2.video_id = p2.video_id and v2.del_flag = '0' where p2.user_id = #{userId} and p2.course_id = c.course_id order by p2.update_time desc, p2.progress_id desc limit 1) as lastLessonTitle, date_format(max(p.update_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as lastStudyTime from learning_course c join learning_course_video v on v.course_id = c.course_id and v.del_flag = '0' left join learning_course_progress p on p.user_id = #{userId} and p.video_id = v.video_id where c.del_flag = '0' group by c.course_id, c.course_name, c.cover_url having count(v.video_id) > 0 and sum(case when p.watched_seconds > 0 then 1 else 0 end) > 0
and count(case when p.finished = 1 then 1 end) < count(v.video_id)
and count(case when p.finished = 1 then 1 end) = count(v.video_id)
order by max(p.update_time) desc
